alphacam_v181_600_registers.header: AI = inch (values/25.4, 4 dec) | AZ = mm (3 dec), from ALPHACAM.MES record 0x0C

N10 block (tool change).#122: tool number (as picked in CHANGE TOOL, e.g. 16)

N20 block (operation).#121: pass number, re-set before every pass
N20 block (operation).#127: operation kind: 6 area clear, 9 grooving, 14 finish pass, 18 drilling, 20 threading (1 = tool block); face clear not yet sampled

alphat_v12_prg_observed.moves: M60 G0 X Z M61 (rapid) / M62 G1 X Z F (feed) / M64 end of feed group; M63 / M65 / M66 macro calls; IF[#140EQn] GOTO 50n restart
alphat_v12_prg_observed.open: Z, feed and thread pitch are all 2x the drawing value (mm and inch); X (diameter) is 1:1; SD1 is unscaled. Consistent pattern -> most likely by design for the T control/macros (Z axis half scale), but verify on the control before cutting.
alphat_v12_prg_observed.per pass: N5nn label; #121=n; M66; IF[#140EQn] GOTO 5nn (restart at pass n); M63; M60 G0 ... M61 rapid; M62 G1 ... feed; M64 after the last pass
alphat_v12_prg_observed.drilling: peck cycle written out as G1 moves (in/out per peck), Z x2; SD1 uses G74 ... G174
alphat_v12_prg_observed.threading: per pass: M60 G0 to start M61; M62; #121=n; M66; G32 X<dia> Z<end> F<pitch x2>; U<dx> W<-pitch x2> (retract starts one pitch before the end, V1.21); G0 out; SD1 uses G76 ... G176
alphat_v12_prg_observed.move/rapid to cursor: no N20 header; moves appended to the current tool block: M62 G1 X Z F / M60 G0 X Z M61
alphat_v12_prg_observed.grooving: plunges written as G1 in / G1 out (+2 on diameter) per stepover, Z x2; #125/#126 = groove limits; SD1 uses G75 ... G175 with the groove contour
